about: Native command-line tools for macOS arm64 that the AI and AI-written scenes use through the app's shell. Only prebuilt binaries published by the projects themselves (or the build the project's own download page links to), self-contained apart from macOS system libraries. tools/native/catalog.py resolves this into web/native.json. Not available as such binaries (so not listed): ImageMagick, tesseract, poppler (xpdf-tools covers pdftotext/pdftoppm), whisper.cpp (releases ship no macOS CLI), sqlite3 (part of macOS).

tools.source: https://ffmpeg.martin-riedl.de (static macOS arm64 builds linked from ffmpeg.org/download.html)
tools.description: FFmpeg and FFprobe: convert, cut, mix and inspect audio and video
tools.purpose: transcoding, trimming, extracting audio or frames, thumbnails, GIFs, probing media metadata (ffprobe -of json)

tools.description: yt-dlp: download video, audio and metadata from YouTube and 1000+ sites
tools.purpose: fetching media or its metadata/subtitles from video sites (-J for JSON, -x for audio)

tools.description: Pandoc: convert between Markdown, HTML, DOCX, ODT, EPUB, LaTeX and more
tools.purpose: document conversion (md ↔ docx/html/epub/odt), extracting text from Word files

tools.description: jq: query and transform JSON on the command line
tools.purpose: filtering, reshaping and pretty-printing JSON from APIs and tools

tools.description: ripgrep (rg): very fast recursive text search
tools.purpose: searching files and folders by content (rg --json for structured results)

tools.description: ExifTool: read and write metadata of photos, videos, PDFs and audio
tools.purpose: camera/GPS/date metadata, renaming photos by date, stripping metadata (exiftool -json)

tools.description: Xpdf tools: pdftotext, pdftoppm, pdftopng, pdfinfo, pdfimages, pdffonts
tools.purpose: extracting text, images and info from PDFs, rendering PDF pages to images

tools.description: QPDF: merge, split, rotate, decrypt, repair and linearize PDFs
tools.purpose: PDF page operations without re-rendering (qpdf --empty --pages a.pdf b.pdf -- out.pdf)

tools.description: 7-Zip (7zz): pack and unpack 7z, zip, rar, tar, gz, xz, iso and more
tools.purpose: opening any archive format (7zz x file -oDIR), creating 7z/zip archives

tools.description: DuckDB: SQL on CSV, Parquet and JSON files, fast analytics
tools.purpose: querying and aggregating data files with SQL (duckdb -json -c "select ... from 'f.csv'")
finding files by name or extension (fd -e pdf . ~/Documents)

tools.description: yq: query and edit YAML, TOML, XML and JSON
tools.purpose: reading and editing config files (yq '.a.b' f.yaml, -o json)

tools.description: Typst: typeset documents to PDF from simple markup
tools.purpose: making good-looking PDFs (letters, invoices, reports) from markup

tools.description: fzf: fuzzy finder and fuzzy filter for lists
